_comment: Rules enforced by scripts/py/validate.py in the 'validate' pipeline stage. This is the 'controlled change management' part: the merge request cannot be merged if it breaks these.
_comment_discover_exclude: export --discover skips technical names matching these regexes. SAP.TIME.* are the time-dimension objects Datasphere generates per space (only business names/time settings are editable) - they are not versioned.
